newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila power firm invites bids for 304 MW project.
newsitem.headline: Manila power firm invites bids for 304 MW project.

text.p: Philippines National Power Corp (Napocor) said on Tuesday it had invited bids for the construction of a 304 megawatt power project in Batangas in northern Philippines.

A consortium called the San Pascual Cogeneration Co has already made an offer to build the plant but under government rules the state-owned Napocor is required to invite others and offer the contract to the best bidder.
San Pascual Cogeneration Co is a consortium of Caltex Philippines Inc, a unit of Caltex Petroleum Corp, Texaco Inc and Edison Mission Energy.

The consortium offered to build the 304-mw low sulphur fuel-fired power plant that will supply power to Napocor and produce steam for use by the adjacent Caltex refinery and a coconut oil refining plant, Cocochem.
Napocor said it would receive project proposals on January 9, 1997. A pre-bid conference is scheduled for November 12 this year.
